newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares steady, Solidere mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares steady, Solidere mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Bank shares were unchanged and Solidere shares were mixed on higher turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday.
Banque Audi held steady at $17 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce at $12.5. Solidere A fell slightly to $10.375 from $10.5 and B held steady at $10.75.

Turnover in Banque Audi fell to 13,000 from 14,010 a day earlier. It included a block trade of 3,000 shares at $17 on the floor of the bourse. Some 9,000 BLC shares were traded, up from Wednesday's 5,651.
Also traded were 3,100 Ciments Libanais shares at $1.1875 slightly up from $1.1562 on February 14 when they were last traded.
There was no trade in the three other listed firms: Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
Total BSE turnover was 81,925 shares for a value of $931,925 against Wednesday's 79,847 shares and $912,277.
The BLOM index dropped 0.31 percent to 903.26.
